Editor's note—
Ord. No.
4749
, § 1, adopted Jan. 25, 2021, repealed the former Art. II., §§ 787-181—78-191, and
               enacted a new Art. II as set out herein. The former Art. II pertained to similar subject
               matter and derived from 1960 Code, §§ 7-49, 7-50—7-56; 1981 Code, §§ 27-167—27-176;
               Ord. No. 2089, §§ 1, 2, adopted Sept. 4, 1984; Ord. No. 2381, §§ 1, 2, adopted Jan.
               5, 1987; Ord. No. 2444, §§ 1, 2, adopted Sept. 21, 1987; Ord. No. 2968, § 1, adopted
               April 5, 1993; Ord. No. 3113, § 1, adopted Sept 19, 1994; Ord. No. 3239, §§ 1, 2,
               adopted Dec. 18, 1995; Ord. No. 3319, §§ 1, 2, adopted Dec. 18, 1996; Ord. No. 3500,
               § 1, adopted Jan. 4, 1999; Ord. No. 3725, §§ 1—3, adopted Oct. 22, 2001; Ord. No.
               4047. § 2, adopted Jan. 8, 2007 ; Ord. No. 4148, § 1, adopted Oct. 19, 2009.
